AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: EkiBoard provides multi-region live public transport departure boards (UK/London, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, Sydney), walk-adjusted concourse comparisons, disruption alerts, last-train checks, Delay Repay receipts, and live journey tracking. Operational Patterns: - Use 'getLiveDepartures' when the user asks for upcoming trains, buses, departures, or timetables at a station. - Use 'compareTwinConcourses' when the user asks which of two nearby stations or concourses is faster or catchable right now. - Use 'checkLineDisruptions' when the user asks about delays, suspensions, or line status. - Use 'getLastTrainHome' when the user asks for the last train or latest departure from a station. - Use 'getSavedDelayRepayReceipts' when the user asks about delayed train compensation or Delay Repay claims. - Use 'trackDeparture' when the user asks to track a journey or train countdown to a destination. - Use 'pinStation' when the user asks to save, bookmark, or pin a station to their dashboard. - Use 'requestWidgetPin' when the user asks to add a station or Smart Commute widget to their home screen. Constraints: - stationName must be provided for station-specific queries. - Destination is required for trackDeparture.
